scripts.install-dev: bun install && bunx husky && bun --cwd ./plugins/mia-core run install-dev
scripts.lint-front: echo 'Frontend lint not implemented (see mia-core plugin).' && bun --cwd ./plugins/mia-core run lint-front
scripts.lint-tests: echo 'Tests lint not implemented yet.' && bun --cwd ./plugins/mia-core run lint-tests
scripts.lint: bun run lint-back && bun run lint-front && bun run lint-tests
scripts.clean-front: echo 'Clean front not implemented (see mia-core plugin).'
scripts.clean: bun run clean-back && bun run clean-front
scripts.build-back: bun run clean-back && bunx tsc --project ./tsconfig.json && bun --cwd ./plugins/mia-core run build-back
scripts.build-front: echo 'Build front not implemented (see mia-core plugin).' && bun --cwd ./plugins/mia-core run build-front
scripts.build: bun run build-back && bun run build-front
scripts.check-requires: bunx used-deps-analyzer "./package.json" "./lib/src" --no-dev --shadows @fortawesome/fontawesome-free bootstrap --misscalled "{ \"module\": \"@fortawesome/fontawesome-free\", \"call\": \"@fortawesome\" }" && bun --cwd ./plugins/mia-core run check-requires
scripts.tests: bun run lint && bun run check-node-engine && bun run check-requires && bun run check-updates && bun run build && bun run unit-tests
scripts.daemon-stop: bunx pm2 stop pm2.json && bunx pm2 delete pm2.json
scripts.docker-start: docker image build --rm -t image-mia . && docker container run -dti -p 8000:8000 --name container-mia image-mia
scripts.docker-stop: docker container stop container-mia && docker container remove -f container-mia && docker image remove -f image-mia
